extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from job metadata: AO3407A, UMW Youtai Semiconductor Co Ltd, p-channel MOSFET.

The supplied seven-page PDF title is UMW AO3407A -30V P-Channel MOSFET. The document footer identifies UTD Semiconductor Co.,Limited and shows Nov.2024; the manufacturer field remains the requested UMW Youtai Semiconductor Co Ltd identity.
P-channel electrical quantities retain the signed values printed in the datasheet. Capacitance and resistance values remain positive SI quantities.

Both typical and maximum RDS(ON) values are transcribed for both published VGS/ID conditions. The maximum values are inclusive table maxima: 0.048 ohm at VGS = -10 V and ID = -4.1 A, and 0.065 ohm at VGS = -4.5 V and ID = -3 A.
The gate-threshold table publishes MIN = -1 V, TYP = -1.8 V, and MAX = -3 V at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 uA.

The capacitance table publishes Ciss = 700 pF, Coss = 120 pF, and Crss = 75 pF at VGS = 0 V, VDS = -15 V, and f = 1 MHz; the shared condition is taken from the electrical-characteristics table context and converted to SI farads.

Curve points are compact direct readings from the supplied typical plots on p. 3 and p. 4. No points were generated by interpolation. The output curves use the separately readable VGS = -3 V, -3.5 V, -4 V, and -4.5 V traces; the transfer curves retain the 25 degC and 125 degC traces; the body-diode current axis is logarithmic.
The supplied datasheet does not state a revision identifier beyond the Nov.2024 document date.
